The main internal structures are shown in the abdominal region, and long strip-like tissues and organs of different colors can be seen. Label D is located in the lower middle part of the body, and the arrow points to a group of slender colored tissues inside the abdomen. Reasoning: The question asks which label corresponds to the ovary. The ovary is a reproductive organ inside the abdomen, not the head, antennae, legs, or an external structure. In the figure, the arrow pointing to reproductive tissue inside the abdomen is labeled D, so the ovary is represented by label D.
